title: Toward Socially Aware Vision-Language Models: Evaluating Cultural Competence Through Multimodal Story Generation
reasoning: The paper benchmarks cultural competence using the World Values Survey (WVS) and Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions, which quantify moral and religious values. It also includes human evaluation on ethical dimensions like 'Stereotype Avoidance' and 'Respectful Representation,' and features specific tasks involving religious contexts such as 'places of worship' and 'prayer' and moral philosophies like 'Ubuntu'.
